### 11. Data

| Field | Content |
|---|---|
| Service | The service that owns the deployment record |
| Environment | SIT, UAT or PROD |
| Image digest | The digest of the promoted image |
| Migration versions applied | The versions applied on start, in version order |
| Drift result | The result of the drift gate |
| Route version | The version of the registered route |
| startedAt | The start time of the deployment |
| endedAt | The end time of the deployment |
| Status | The outcome of the deployment |
